description: This file defines a UI widget class 'MafCommand' that creates a panel with a spinner control for adjusting the MAF sensor value. It interacts with the 'EcuStimulator' and 'Sensor' classes to set voltage based on user input.

classes.name: MafCommand
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component for user interaction to adjust MAF sensor values through a spinner control.

methods.name: MafCommand
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel, adds a label and a spinner for MAF value adjustment, and sets up a change listener to update the ECU stimulator.
